oldExamples.boundary: Every sentence was scanned for the listed structural and lexical heuristics. Lack of English token overlap may be a synonym, grammar, or paraphrase issue; flags do not prove mistranslation. This is not a claim of full manual linguistic review.

refinement.reviewBoundary: All retained entries received source-assisted enrichment. All 1000 new short modern senses, Chinese sentence pairs, English translations and semantic groups received AI contextual authoring/review. Preserved old examples received structural/lexical heuristic scans and targeted fixes, not full individual linguistic review. AI review is not human sign-off, independent authority verification or a complete polyphonic pronunciation audit.
refinement.sourceProvenanceCaveat: Upstream advertises MIT but notes that the original provenance of some collected material cannot be established. This data is retained as an attributed reference, not certified authoritative lexicography.

newIdiomContentQa.boundary: AI dictionary/context review and structural checks; machine-assisted English and sentence pinyin; no human sign-off or device/runtime proof

idiomDistractorReview.reviewMethod: AI anchor-based source/context review with structural validation; no claim of complete semantic equivalence proof.
